_doc: Dark Knight line (spec #348, ticket D2 #350). Skills are defined here by D5-D9 (spec #348). Skill keys a job names before they are defined stay inert: undefined skills are never offered or learned. Power Strike and Slash Blast stay in skills/hero.json (DK-13): never define them here.

spear_crusher._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 1311001 at its eight mapped levels (4 8 12 15 23 25 27 30): damage 70 to 170 %, attackCount 2 (levels 1-15) or 3 (16-30), mobCount 1 to 3, the box lt (-130,-50) growing to (-150,-70) with rb (-16,0) (a 16 px dead zone in front of the knight), the per-level body action (burster1 for two hits, burster2 for three), the wings (effect) and rune rings (effect0), the K-th dragon thrust (effect1..3), hit/0 and the Use sound; the pole arm twin 1311002 has identical numbers and nodes. Tier B: effectK is the K-th thrust (D1 contact sheet; the blank wait of effect1/2/3 is 600/750/900 ms, the body's thrusts land there). Tier C: the explicit ranks table (DK-7: the default level-30 table lands rank 5 on level 19, where mobCount falls back to 1, so the rank would deal less than rank 4), the 0.6 s cooldown, the nearest-target admission (min_targets 1), the bonuses, a Final Attack hit also showing its thrust. Docs: GAME_DESIGN 7.70.
spear_crusher.name: Spear Crusher
spear_crusher.desc: Thrust your spear into the monsters in front of you, two or three times.

text.desc: Thrust your weapon into the monsters in front of you.

beholder._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 1321007 art (summon summoned/stand/move/die/skill1-6, the owner-side affected column), the alert2 stance, the Use sound, ranks reading Beholder levels 2 3 4 5 7 8 9 10 through rank_levels["10"]. Tier B: skill1 is the Aura animation and skill2-6 the five Hex runes (D1 contact sheet); affected plays on the knight at each pulse (D4). Tier C: the 60 s life (buff.duration, the WZ time is 720-1200 s, DK-6), the 45 s cooldown counted from the cast, the 3 s first Hex pulse, the follow settings (Elquines'), the bonuses. WZ mpCon and mastery are not used. Aura and Hex are the sub-skills below. Docs: GAME_DESIGN 7.72.
beholder._rarity: Tier C: first-pass #357 bonuses (spec #348): Rare Aura of the Beholder heal x1.3 (support_heal), Epic Hex of the Beholder pulses 25% sooner (support_rate x0.75), Unique Twin Beholder +1 Beholder (summon_count), Legendary Twin plus heal x1.3 (the Beholder has no damage; Twin shares one id and repeat counter). Repeat scale 0.8. GAME_DESIGN 7.72 and 8.
beholder.name: Beholder
beholder.desc: Summon a Beholder who floats beside you, heals you and buffs your defence, accuracy, avoidability and attack.

text.desc: Summons a Beholder that follows you. It heals you with Aura of the Beholder and buffs you with Hex of the Beholder.

aura_of_the_beholder._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 1320008 canonical hp (85 to 500, flat) and x (10 to 4 s) at the eight sub levels. A summon_sub of the Beholder (DK-4): never owned, never in a pool, no card; it ranks with its parent through this explicit table (a level-25 skill has no default table). Docs: GAME_DESIGN 7.72.
aura_of_the_beholder.name: Aura of the Beholder
aura_of_the_beholder.desc: The Beholder heals you every few seconds.

hex_of_the_beholder._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 1320009 canonical pdd mdd acc eva pad (each from its unlock level 1 6 11 16 21), time and x at the eight sub levels; a stat absent from the level is not carried. WZ eva is the avoid total and pad the weapon attack (tier C mapping). A summon_sub of the Beholder (DK-4, DK-5): every unlocked stat applies together, a pulse refreshes the one buff entry. Docs: GAME_DESIGN 7.72.
hex_of_the_beholder.name: Hex of the Beholder
hex_of_the_beholder.desc: The Beholder buffs your defence, accuracy, avoidability and attack every few seconds.
